In context, this example shows that using the free online homework system, MyOpenMath, helps to
increase student grades. Further, the increase appears to be about 6.6 percentage points, which
could make the difference between passing or not passing a course, or the difference between letter
grades. Example 1 quoted the statistic that 65% of students will skip purchasing textbooks, and
many will also skip or delay purchasing access to a publisher’s expensive homework platform. As a
result, these students are prone to starting late, missing homework, and having lower overall scores.
Offering free access to books and homework platforms is one way that we can equitably assist
